shortDescription: Perform a upgrade with lcm upgrade api

options.name: api_version_number
options.description: Specify the API version to perform the upgrade.

options.name: auto_witness_upgrade
options.description: Automatically upgrade the witness node by VxRail

options.name: bundle
options.description: the path of lcm bundle on vxm, which is recommended under /data/store2

options.name: ecosystem_check_components
options.description: The ecosystem pre-check will be ignored according to the value in "continue_with_incompatible" and "components".

options.name: ecosystem_check_continue_with_incompatible
options.description: if set to true, will ignore the ecosystem pre-check according to the inputs in "continue_with_incompatible" and "components".

options.name: enable_quick_boot
options.description: Enable quick boot to reduce reboot time.

options.name: enforce_quick_patch
options.description: Enable quick patch to apply patches without VM evacuation or host reboot.

options.name: missing_file_check
options.description: If you are using the customizing upgrade bundle i.e. Smart Bundle, this option should be set to false.

options.name: parallel_remediation_enable
options.description: Enable parallel remediation. For Dynamic Node only

options.name: parallel_remediation_max
options.description: Assign the maximum number of hosts to enter maintenance mode at a time and perform remediation.

options.name: preferred_fault_domain_first
options.description: Upgrade preferred fault domain hosts first

options.name: psc_root_account
options.description: root account of the PSC the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: psc_root_passwd
options.description: The password for the root account provided in PSC

options.name: retry_as_standard
options.description: Enable retry as standard to disable live patch and retry upgrade automatically.

options.name: skip_failed_hosts
options.description: If set to true, any nodes that fail the upgrade will be ignored.

options.name: source_psc_host_name
options.description: Hostname of the ESXi host

options.name: source_psc_host_user_name
options.description: The username of account provided in the ESXi host

options.name: source_psc_host_user_passwd
options.description: The password of account provided in the ESXi host

options.name: source_vcsa_host_name
options.description: Hostname of the ESXi host

options.name: source_vcsa_host_user_name
options.description: The username of account provided in the ESXi host

options.name: source_vcsa_host_user_passwd
options.description: The password of account provided in the ESXi host

options.name: target_hosts_name
options.description: target hosts name for partial upgrade

options.name: target_vcsa_host_name
options.description: Hostname of the ESXi host

options.name: target_vcsa_host_user_name
options.description: The username of account provided in the ESXi host

options.name: target_vcsa_host_user_passwd
options.description: The password of account provided in the ESXi host

options.name: temporary_gateway
options.description: Gateway to be used during the vCenter upgrade

options.name: temporary_ip
options.description: Temporary IP to be used during the vCenter upgrade

options.name: temporary_netmask
options.description: Netmask to be used during the vCenter upgrade

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time out value for LCM Upgrade, the default value is 21600 seconds

options.name: vc_root_account
options.description: root account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vc_root_passwd
options.description: The password for the root account provided in vcroot

options.name: vcadmin
options.description: Administrative account of the vCenter Server the VxRail Manager is registered to

options.name: vcpasswd
options.description: The password for the administrator account provided in vcadmin

options.name: vxm_root_account
options.description: root account of VxRail Manager

options.name: vxm_root_passwd
options.description: The password for the root account provided in vxm

options.name: vxmip
options.description: The IP address of the VxRail Manager System

options.name: witness_password
options.description: Password of the witness account

options.name: witness_username
options.description: Username of the witness account
